# FIN6 SMOKE (16 nodes, two 8-node groups, segment 8, limit 7000 s per group): FIN6 SMOKE (SMOKE=1, short windows; refreeze validation + every new knob before the finals).
# Generated by gen_finals_v6.py (review/FINALS_PLAN.md v6 + PRE-REG; schedule in review/FINALS_SCHEDULE_v6.md).
# Wheel build-freeze-58caa0fde6 (= v5-final 58caa0fde6), no overlay. One pinned tactic table per mode from the
# rehearsal's tuning passes (FT_COST_E2E_SEED). 300 s windows (COST_MAX_WAVES=40 lifts the 20-wave cap).
# Kill victims rotate per repeat: no-EPLB ranks 5/22, nodes 1/5; online ranks 13/29, nodes 3/7 (KF_VICTIM_*).
# G0: gate (<10 min) + no-EPLB all arm kinds, seeded, 8 (24 waves: the lifted 20-wave cap) + 32: ~66
# G8: gate + online-ft and offline-ft seeded @32 + no-EPLB node1 (node 5), twokill (22 then 26), deadline (22, late 26): ~66
R=/lustre/fs1/portfolios/coreai/projects/coreai_comparch_trtllm/users/arusli/src/TensorRT-LLM/.wideep-ft-runs/claude
grep -q "^$(hostname -s) " $R/mvp/EXCLUDE_NODES.txt && { echo "EXCLUDED_NODE $(hostname -s)"; exit 1; }
B=build-freeze-58caa0fde6; MB=build-main-9cc37929e8
SMOKE=${SMOKE:-1}
if [[ $SMOKE == 1 ]]; then
    IT_MAIN=32=6,128=3 IT_HX=8=24,32=6,128=3,512=1 BURN=32:2 KI=4 KI32=8 KSTOP=4 CRR=rank5
else
    IT_MAIN=32=28,128=12 IT_HX=8=39,32=28,128=12,512=4 BURN=32:6 KI=4 KI32=16 KSTOP=8 CRR='rank5 rank5'
fi
SNO=$R/mvp/runs/STD-8193512/autotuner/pinned.json
SON=$R/mvp/runs/STD-G1-8193512/autotuner/pinned.json
SOFF=$R/mvp/runs/STD-8194123/autotuner/pinned.json
HD="TLLM_FAULT_TOLERANCE_HANG_DETECTION=1 TLLM_FAULT_TOLERANCE_HANG_CONFIRM_S=30"
E="MVP_BUILD=$B FINAL_BUILD=$B MAIN_BUILD=$MB WIDEEP_NO_SAMPLERS=1 WIDEEP_POLLUTION_CHECKS=1 WIDEEP_DMON=1 WIDEEP_BURNIN=$BURN STD_PLACEMENT=$R/mvp/runs/STD-8109649/std-offline-placement.yaml $HD FT_COST_E2E_ROUNDS=1 COST_MAX_WAVES=40 COST_CASE_TIMEOUT_S=3000"
MAIN="COST_LOADS=32,128 COST_LOAD_ITERATIONS=$IT_MAIN"
HX="COST_LOADS=8,32,128,512 COST_LOAD_ITERATIONS=$IT_HX"
KS=200
M="--mca btl_tcp_if_include eth0 --mca coll ^hcoll,ucc"
K="MVP_BUILD=$B FINAL_BUILD=$B WIDEEP_MPI_MCA='$M' $HD WIDEEP_FAILURE_DOMAIN=node KF_ITERATIONS=$KI WIDEEP_POLLUTION_CHECKS=1 KF_GRAPH_SIZES=136,148 WIDEEP_KILL_IN_DECODE_STEADY=1 KF_STOP_ITERATIONS=$KSTOP"
KNO="$K KF_BENCH_CONFIG=std-noeplb-ft.yaml KF_VICTIM_RANKS='5 22' KF_VICTIM_NODES='1 5'"
KON="$K KF_BENCH_CONFIG=std-online.yaml KF_VICTIM_RANKS='13 29' KF_VICTIM_NODES='3 7'"
D="MVP_BUILD=$B FINAL_BUILD=$B CR_KEEP_PAGE_CACHE=1 WIDEEP_KILL_AFTER_STEPS=$KS"
A="MVP_BUILD=$B FINAL_BUILD=$B $HD"
run() { echo "bash $R/mvp/harness/run_job.sh $1"; }
T="tests/unittest/_torch/executor/kv_cache/test_kv_pool_rebalance.py tests/unittest/_torch/executor/test_multimodal_scheduler.py tests/unittest/_torch/moe/test_ring_host_copies.py tests/unittest/executor/test_recovery_authority.py tests/unittest/_torch/moe/test_moe_execution_state.py tests/unittest/_torch/moe/test_moe_load_balancer.py tests/unittest/_torch/distributed/test_mpi_survivors.py tests/unittest/_torch/distributed/test_mpi_survivors_ulfm.py tests/unittest/_torch/executor/test_py_executor.py"
g() { echo "bash $R/tools/units_gate.sh $R/logs/bundle/fin6smoke-gate$1-\$SLURM_JOB_ID $R/$B/dist $R/overlays/build-src-8c52d11469 $R/overlays/build-src-8c52d11469 $R/overlays/build-src-8c52d11469 $R/$B/point-units-fin6smoke-g$1 $T"; }
P0_1="$E COST_LOADS=8,32 COST_LOAD_ITERATIONS=8=24,32=6 FT_COST_E2E_SEED=$SNO FT_COST_E2E_ROUND_MIN=$((SMOKE ? 10 : 0)) FT_COST_E2E_ARMS='std-noeplb std-noeplb-ft std-noeplb-main std-noeplb-lb std-noeplb-ulfm' $(run STD)"
G0="{ $P0_1; }"
P8_1="$E COST_LOADS=32 COST_LOAD_ITERATIONS=32=6 FT_COST_E2E_SEED=$SON FT_COST_E2E_ROUND_MIN=$((SMOKE ? 10 : 0)) FT_COST_E2E_ARMS='std-online-ft' $(run STD-G1)"
P8_2="$E COST_LOADS=32 COST_LOAD_ITERATIONS=32=6 FT_COST_E2E_SEED=$SOFF FT_COST_E2E_ROUND_MIN=$((SMOKE ? 10 : 0)) FT_COST_E2E_ARMS='std-offline-ft' $(run STD-G3)"
P8_3="$K KF_BENCH_CONFIG=std-noeplb-ft.yaml KF_VICTIM_RANKS=22 KF_VICTIM_NODES=5 KF_ROWS='node1 twokill deadline' KF_REPEATS=1 $(run KILL-FINAL-OFF)"
G8="{ $P8_1; $P8_2; $P8_3; }"
if [[ -n ${FIN_GROUP:-} ]]; then
    v=G$FIN_GROUP; [[ -n ${FIN_PART:-} ]] && v=P${FIN_GROUP}_$FIN_PART
    [[ -n ${!v:-} ]] || { echo "DRY_RUN_FAIL no $v in $0"; exit 1; }
    bash -c "${!v}"; exit
fi
bash $R/bundle.sh "0:8:7000:$(g 0) && $G0" "8:8:7000:$(g 8) && $G8"
